label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform, Identity, Rewards and Support, plus Conversational AI, Uvation Pulse, Atlas CRM, Devops and Design Marketing Development Collab
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: On 3 Nov the Magento 2.4.9 upgrade (MT-1615), the core upgrade (MT-1617) and most of its module subtasks held by Naman Bapna, Parth and shubham kuchwar moved from UAT to Ready For Prod; 40 of its subtasks and 42 MT items in all now wait at Ready For Prod, which is not a Done status, so the upgrade subtasks stay past their 30 and 31 Oct dates. Eleven items closed, including ten Uvation module compatibility checks and reviews (MT-1693 to MT-1728) and the Send a Quote go-live check (MT-1773); Parth started two more checks (MT-1712, MT-1713) and shubham kuchwar the Request for Quote check (MT-1772, due 4 Nov). The GraphQL 403, wishlist and chatbot RFQ redirect fixes moved to In Prod (MT-1754, MT-1760, MT-1761). Naman Bapna raised a Highest checkout bug where store credit equal to the order total is rejected (MT-1778, Ready For Prod), and Shashi Prasad K raised a Quote Dashboard story with no owner (MT-1779, due 30 Nov). 56 items are past due, unchanged.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: On 3 Nov 36 MR items closed, mostly the page validation bugs and their subtasks for the Nuclear Energy, Partners, SLA and Terms, Homepage and People pages (MR-1419 to MR-1456). Kannan Elangovan raised a new design validation bug for the Case Studies, Insights, Events and header pages (MR-1460, Vishnu kumar yadav) with six subtasks for Vishnu kumar yadav and Saurabh Jain, all due 13 Nov (MR-1461 to MR-1466). Kunal Jangid moved the header, footer, Case Studies, Events and Insights updates to Code Review (MR-1405 to MR-1407, MR-1409, MR-1410), and the People, Partners and SLA page updates went back from Code Review to In Progress (MR-1399, MR-1402, MR-1404). The v1.2 revamp (MR-1379) is still open past 30 Oct. 29 items are past due, down from 63.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: On 3 Nov 51 USP items were closed, 48 of them from Deployed In Prod, including the IAM story and its nine subtasks (USP-4234 to USP-4243), the payment and invoice changes (USP-4281 to USP-4290), the subscription dashboard items (USP-4358 to USP-4366), the request-quote wait step (USP-4396 to USP-4400) and the storage configurator (USP-4404 to USP-4411); 22 items remain Deployed In Prod. Cășvan Marcel moved the subscription upgrade epic and its stories back to TODO (USP-4343, USP-3379, USP-3400, USP-3401, USP-4346 to USP-4349, due 15 Dec). 18 items were re-dated to 15 Nov, including the S1 Document API 502 (USP-4231, TODO), the Highest seat-claims security bug (USP-4369, Deployed In Dev), Support Hub v2 (USP-4252) and the Communication Hub re-skin and Book a meeting stories (USP-4295, USP-4298). Livian Stefan Stan raised a Highest end-to-end Book a meeting story for Anshul Bhargava (USP-4438, due 15 Nov), a production DB clean-up and production smoke tests (USP-4436, USP-4437), and started renaming quote wording to Proposal (USP-4433, due 6 Nov). The pricing-rule eval security bug (USP-4414) passed its 2 Nov date in TODO. 139 items are past due, down from 197.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: On 3 Nov Kannan Elangovan raised more chatbot testing bugs for Ankit Saxena (UC-414, due 3 Nov) with three subtasks now in Dev (UC-415 to UC-417: clarifying questions, the signed-in user's name, and recommendations that change with GDPR consent), and a High bug where chatbot responses time out on the Marketing and Marketplace dev environments (UC-418, no due date). Ankit Saxena started the in-chat RFQ flow and its CRM integration (UC-23, due 13 Nov; UC-45, re-dated to 4 Nov) and the ambiguous-query bug (UC-413); the own-records experience (UC-19) went back from Dev Testing to In Dev. Nareddy Shiva Prasad Reddy started the multi-turn regression pass and the availability-check flow (UC-107, UC-149). Shivam Dhoundiyal moved the admin landing page layout and KPI tiles to Code Review (UC-403, UC-404) and started the landing page story and the Today drawer and chat history page (UC-402, UC-405, due 4 Nov). 67 items are past due, up from 66.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: Naveen Jangid closed on-prem production deployment (PULSE-10) on 30 Oct and Sarath Chandra closed the production deployment pipeline set-up (PULSE-333), together with the Pulse pipeline work on the Devops board (IN-1165 to IN-1168). No PULSE item is past due. Most PULSE tickets were last touched in a bulk update on 29 Sep and are outside the 30-day window. Anshul Bhargava's Interactive AI Factory tasks sit on the PRD board, outside this report's boards.
